name: sprint15_qhour_open_spy_v3
hypothesis: Quarter-hour boundary VWAP-slicing algo flow (arXiv 2607.09426) predicts 15m drift on SPY RTH bars — untested twice (sprint11, sprint14) due to a CONFIRMED DATA-DEFECT: qr/sprint/data.py only resolves Binance spot symbols via data.binance.vision; it has no equity loader, so SPY requests silently 404 every month and return n=0.
power_argument: SPY 15m return stdev ~15bp; SE at n=300 ~0.87bp, min detectable edge at t=2 ~1.7bp, well below the ~26bp T2 cost floor measured on crypto (C0/C1). 26 boundary bars/day RTH, cap 8/day x ~63 validation days = up to 504 possible entries, clears the 300 floor.
prerequisite: BLOCKED until data.py gains a free equity 1m RTH loader with the same point-in-time integrity as the crypto loader. Do not register/run before that lands — a third n=0 burns a queue slot for zero information.
